connectionGuide.dsh: DeepSeek Harness: get a DeepSeek API key, install the agent, then open its settings to configure it. Official project: github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness (developer preview).
connectionGuide.title: Connection guide: accounts, API keys and billing
connectionGuide.choice: Already use a local agent? Choose Local agent to reuse its sign-in and configuration. For pay-as-you-go model access, choose Custom API and enter a key from that API platform.
connectionGuide.deepseek: DeepSeek API: add credit and create an API key at the DeepSeek platform (platform.deepseek.com).
connectionGuide.qwen: Qwen API: enable model services and create an API key in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (bailian.console.aliyun.com), with usage-based billing.
connectionGuide.kimi: Kimi API: add credit and create an API key on the China platform (platform.kimi.com). Its API request URL is {{baseUrl}}.
connectionGuide.kimiCode: Kimi Code CLI: activate a membership at Kimi Code (kimi.com/code), then install the CLI and sign in through the terminal.
connectionGuide.qoder: Qoder CN CLI: activate a plan or claim an available trial at Qoder CN (qoder.cn), then install the CLI and sign in through the terminal.
connectionGuide.billing: Check charges and remaining quota with your provider. Installing an agent does not grant free model usage. Trial quotas and membership benefits depend on your provider account.
connectionGuide.codex: Codex CLI: install and sign in with ChatGPT, or configure an OpenAI API key. Usage is billed to the selected account or service. Setup: developers.openai.com/codex/auth.
connectionGuide.claude: Claude Code: install and sign in with an eligible Claude account, or configure a model service. Billing follows the selected account or service. Setup: code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication.
connectionGuide.gemini: Gemini CLI: install and sign in with Google, or configure a Gemini API key / Vertex AI. Setup: geminicli.com/docs/get-started/authentication/.
connectionGuide.qwenCode: Qwen Code: an open-source terminal agent from the Qwen team. Install it and configure an API key for Model Studio or another model provider. Setup: qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/zh/users/configuration/auth/.
connectionGuide.qoderInternational: Qoder international: its website is qoder.com; Qoder CN is the mainland China edition listed above. Qwen Code is a separate product. This app currently supports Qoder CN CLI.
connectionGuide.glm: GLM API: enable model services and create an API key on the Zhipu platform (open.bigmodel.cn).
connectionGuide.doubao: Doubao API: enable model services and create an API key on Volcengine Ark (console.volcengine.com/ark).
connectionGuide.openai: OpenAI API: set up API billing and create an API key on the OpenAI platform (platform.openai.com).
connectionGuide.openrouter: OpenRouter API: add credit and create an API key on OpenRouter (openrouter.ai) to use its available models.
